extracted.name: Coconut Squares
extracted.description: My coconut bars are crispier, sweeter and bake for daily snacks for my kids...
ingredient_lines: 3 large eggs 1 can (14 ounces) sweetened condensed milk
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°. Line a 13x9-in. baking pan with parchment, letting ends extend up sides.
In a large bowl, mix flour, designated coconut,brown sugar and salt; stir in 1 cup melted butter, condensed milk,eggs and vanilla extract. Press onto bottom of prepared pan.
Bake until light golden brown, 25-30 minutes. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Lifting with parchment, remove from pan. Cut into bars.
